notes: Second-option depth for single-route high-demand markets (AU/CA/FR/TH/MY/PH/VN/AE/SG). Sources: official CIS/help PDFs (Optus, CelcomDigi, Smart, Etisalat), carrier sites (Lebara FR), community wikis/forums (Good2Go, VinaPhone, StarHub), MobileTopup help (Thai validity packs). FX: AUD 4.7, CAD 5.3, EUR 7.8, THB 0.2, MYR 1.7, PHP 0.125, VND 0.000028, AED 1.93, SGD 5.5.

routes.acquisitionSummary: Prepaid SIM sold at Optus stores/airports/retail (starter kits from ~$2 on promo); recharge online or in-app. No ID check needed for standard prepaid (passport OK for visitors).

keep.action: Official CIS (plan 200503): Flex Plus recharge tiers include $59 = 186-day expiry and $180 = 365-day expiry. Retention = $59 per 186 days (~$116/yr). WARNING: CIS states price changes from 30 Sep 2026 — re-verify after that date.

routes.chinaActivation: SIM must be activated on Optus network in Australia; China-first activation unverified. eSIM available.
routes.kyc: No strict ID for prepaid; activation via app/online.
routes.payment: Australian/international cards online (community-verified); vouchers in AU retail.
routes.roamingSms: Roaming packs extra; receiving SMS abroad generally free (unverified specifics).

routes.acquisitionSummary: Good2Go Mobile (formerly Petro-Canada Mobility / Ztar), Rogers network. PAYG vouchers sold at Petro-Canada stations; SIM kits online. Long-standing PAYG tradition: $20 voucher = 180 days validity.

keep.action: Community (RedFlagDeals, longstanding): $20 top-up voucher = 180 days validity; 2x per year = ~$40/yr. Post-2025 Rogers 3G shutdown structure unverified (old 3G PAYG users were offered Lucky Mobile migration). Confirm current PAYG terms before relying.

routes.chinaActivation: Canada activation required; China-first activation unverified.
routes.payment: Vouchers (cash-friendly) at Petro-Canada; online top-up via good2gomobile.ca.
routes.roamingSms: No roaming on PAYG (Canada-only service historically).
routes.holdReason: Post-3G-shutdown PAYG structure unverified; community evidence dated. SpeakOut 7-Eleven ($25/yr voucher) remains the proven CA retention route.
routes.tariffSummary: PAYG $20/180d voucher tradition (community); needs current re-verification.

routes.acquisitionSummary: Lebara FR SIM available online (lebara.fr) and in French tabacs/supermarkets; eSIM available. Bouygues network. Top-ups from 5 EUR (official recharge page).

keep.action: Recharge validity ladder (community reseller + official recharge page): 15 EUR = 90 days validity. Retention = 15 EUR per 90 days = 60 EUR/yr. Smaller top-ups (5 EUR) carry shorter validity.

routes.chinaActivation: France activation expected; China-first activation unverified.
routes.kyc: France requires SIM registration (ID/passport) for prepaid activation.
routes.roamingSms: EU roaming included for EU residents; receiving SMS abroad typically free.
routes.tariffSummary: Top-up from 5 EUR; 15 EUR = 90d validity (~60 EUR/yr retention).

routes.acquisitionSummary: Free Mobile 2 EUR/mo plan (official fiche-forfait-2-euros). Online signup with SIM delivered to a French address; France practical requirement: French address + SEPA bank/card payment.

keep.action: Subscription 2 EUR/mo keeps number (official). Cheap retention BUT requires French address for delivery and FR/EU payment — effectively France-resident only.

routes.chinaActivation: Not possible — SIM shipped to French address; activation in France.
routes.kyc: French address + identity info at signup.
routes.roamingSms: EU roaming; receiving SMS abroad generally free.
routes.holdReason: Requires French address + SEPA payment — not viable for non-residents despite cheap 2 EUR/mo.

routes.acquisitionSummary: TrueMove H prepaid SIM widely sold in Thailand (7-Eleven, True shops, airport); passport registration required (Thai law). Existing holders abroad can extend validity remotely.

keep.action: Validity extension packages (MobileTopup help, updated 2026-09-03): 90 days = 35 THB, 180 days = 70 THB, purchasable for any Thai prepaid number from abroad. Retention = 70 THB per 180 days = 140 THB/yr. Check expiry via #123# (TrueMove). Carrier may cap max validity.

routes.chinaActivation: Initial activation in Thailand on TrueMove network; subsequent extensions work from anywhere (online top-up).
routes.kyc: Passport registration required (Thai law, all prepaid).
routes.payment: International top-up sites (MobileTopup etc.) accept foreign cards; True app needs TH-friendly payment.
routes.roamingSms: Receiving SMS abroad works while SIM active (community).
routes.tariffSummary: Validity packs 35 THB/90d, 70 THB/180d = 140 THB/yr retention.

routes.acquisitionSummary: Digi prepaid sold nationwide in Malaysia (7-Eleven, Digi stores); passport registration for foreigners.

keep.action: Official CelcomDigi help (updated 2026-08-12): reload validity ladder (RM100 = 120 days) PLUS dedicated validity extensions via *118*3# or app: RM1/1day, RM12/15days, RM198/365days. Cheapest annual retention = RM198/365d extension. Alternative: RM100 reload per 120d = RM300/yr.

routes.chinaActivation: Malaysia activation expected; extension purchases work from anywhere via app/USSD.
routes.kyc: Passport registration required for foreigners (Malaysian law).
routes.payment: App/online reload; international cards partially accepted (community).
routes.roamingSms: Receiving SMS abroad works while active (community).

routes.acquisitionSummary: Smart Prepaid SIM (~PHP 40) sold everywhere in PH; SIM registration law (RA 11934) requires passport + photo for foreigners.

keep.action: Official Smart help (2024-09): loaded value valid 365 days; when balance hits zero you have 180 days to reload before disconnection (receive-only meanwhile). Retention = keep any small balance + reload at least once per ~180-365 days. Minimum e-load amount unverified (~PHP 10-20 typical).

routes.chinaActivation: Philippines activation expected; GigaLife app works abroad for loading (community).
routes.kyc: Mandatory SIM registration (RA 11934): passport + selfie for foreigners.
routes.payment: GigaLife app / load resellers; international cards partially accepted.
routes.roamingSms: Receiving SMS abroad works while active (community).
routes.tariffSummary: Load valid 365d; zero-balance 180d grace before disconnection (official).

routes.acquisitionSummary: VinaPhone prepaid sold nationwide in Vietnam; passport registration for foreigners (Vietnamese law).

keep.action: Community (dichvudidong.vn): official keep-number packages GS1/GS2 — 60,000 VND adds 180 days, 120,000 VND adds up to 360 days, registered via SMS syntax, available to all subscribers nationwide. Retention = 120,000 VND/yr. NOTE: source dated 2022-10; re-verify package codes still live.

routes.chinaActivation: Vietnam activation expected; SMS package registration needs active SIM.
routes.payment: Vietnamese channels (vouchers, banks); international top-up sites partially support VN.
routes.roamingSms: Receiving SMS abroad works while active (community).

routes.acquisitionSummary: e& (Etisalat) Wasel prepaid sold at UAE airports/stores; Emirates ID for residents, passport for visitors (tourist prepaid variants exist).

keep.action: Official Wasel Free Lifetime Validity Rules PDF: line has lifetime validity; if unused for 3 consecutive months, AED 10/quarter is auto-charged to remain in lifetime validity. Without 10 AED balance the line deactivates but number is retained 12 months (revivable by recharge). Retention = keep 40 AED/yr balance, or one usage per quarter. NOTE: PDF dated 2017 — re-verify current terms.

routes.chinaActivation: UAE activation expected; China-first activation unverified.
routes.kyc: Passport for visitors / Emirates ID for residents.
routes.roamingSms: Receiving SMS abroad typically free while active (community).
routes.tariffSummary: Lifetime validity; AED 10/quarter if unused (official 2017 rules).
